lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, with a prominent cluster of three large spots forming a triangular spatial configuration above the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal dermal ridges on the upper flank characterized by high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow gradients on the inferior edge, running parallel to the body axis.
